subject.title: refactor: separate external conversations from local sessions

question: Must this head provide a real two-peer Reef upgrade/restart round trip before merging the new conversation API and SQLite v11 migration, or are the focused tests sufficient?
rationale: Tests cover many branches, but they cannot by themselves prove cross-process queue ownership, transport correlation, real Reef relay behavior, or migration outcomes on an existing user database.

options.title: Require live upgrade proof
options.body: Require redacted evidence from an existing v10 checkout upgraded to v11, followed by two-peer send, turn, restart-recovery, and unsolicited-inbound checks on the exact head.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Merge with the focused migration and queue tests while explicitly accepting that real transport and upgrade behavior will first be exercised after landing.

options.title: Narrow the landing
options.body: Split the core conversation contract and migration from Reef-specific durable-turn behavior so each risk can be proven and reviewed independently.

recommendation.title: Require live upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted evidence from an existing v10 checkout upgraded to v11, followed by two-peer send, turn, restart-recovery, and unsolicited-inbound checks on the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: They sponsor the canonical feature and own the branch spanning the schema, Gateway, delivery, and Reef decisions.
